versions.changelog:
opc-daily-promotion v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a structured daily content curation skill focused on IP promotion and content monetization.
- Delivers 12 top cases daily across four modules: Digital Avatars, Text-to-Image, Text-to-Video, Entrepreneurship/Innovation WeChat Accounts.
- Defines strict quality standards—authentic, actionable, and insightful case studies with complete prompts and clear takeaway points.
- Provides a standardized daily report format, including summary highlights and actionable recommendations.
- Sets a daily execution schedule (8:30 AM), with automated sourcing and selection criteria from leading platforms.
